name: Tariku Błaszczyk-Faanunu
role: Sound sculptor and underground venue musician
description:
Tariku is whip-thin and restless, with deep brown skin and a shaved head except for a single long braid down the back, tipped with a small copper weight that clicks against his collar when he moves. His irises have been modded to shift color with his emotional state — not at his conscious control, which he finds embarrassing and everyone else finds fascinating. He wears the same kind of clothes every day: dark, layered, functional, pockets everywhere, usually with at least one grease stain from working on his equipment.

His art is built around infrasound — frequencies below human hearing that he mixes into otherwise ordinary music to produce physical and emotional responses in his audience: unease, euphoria, the sensation of being watched. He's passionate about this to a degree that makes him exhausting at parties, because he cannot stop talking about psychoacoustics once the subject comes up. Off that topic he's warm and self-deprecating, quick to laugh at himself, genuinely curious about other people's work. He plays three nights a week in a basement venue under a pierogi shop and spends the other nights building custom transducer rigs from salvage.

core_fears: Making something that harms someone — he's aware his infrasound work can be weaponized
Being ordinary; producing work that doesn't matter
core_desires: To make people feel something they've never felt before
To be financially stable enough to stop doing session work he doesn't believe in
coping_mechanisms: Building things with his hands when anxious
Playing for himself alone in the empty venue at 4 AM
blind_spots: Genuinely cannot recognize when someone is romantically interested in him; his emotion-display irises have never once helped him notice this
psychology.secret: He was approached six months ago by a Ringo corponation A&R contact offering a contract — he didn't refuse outright but has been stalling, and every day he doesn't answer feels more like a yes he hasn't said yet

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Technical and enthusiastic about sound; casual and slightly rambly otherwise; Amharic and Polish loanwords mixed into everyday speech without him noticing
speech_patterns.cadence: Fast when excited, which is often; trails off mid-sentence when distracted by an idea
verbal_tics: 'Okay but listen' before any important point
example_lines: 'Okay but listen — it's not about what you hear, it's about what your body decides happened. The ear is just the front door. I want the basement.'
'The pierogi are a tax. You come to my show, you buy pierogi. Madam Kwiatkowska-Obi feeds me. It's ecology.'

story_hooks: Someone has been using infrasound equipment in the neighborhood to induce paranoia in residents — Tariku can identify the frequency signature, and it's disturbingly similar to his own experimental work
His stalling on the Ringo offer is about to expire and he needs to make a decision; he's looking for someone outside his social circle to talk it through with honestly
A new transducer component he sourced from salvage carries corrupted data that, when played through his system, seems to summon or agitate a local ELF
narrative_function: Access point to the Hamtramck underground scene; can source unusual electronic components; his involuntary emotion-display makes him a useful barometer; can design sound environments for specific purposes
augmentations: Emotional-state irises (cosmetic, involuntary color shift — he regrets this); subdermal vibration receivers along his forearms that let him 'feel' his own infrasound mixes; tympanic dampeners to prevent hearing damage
daily_life: Sleeps until noon, spends afternoons in salvage markets or soldering, eats dinner at the collective's shared kitchen, performs or experiments in the basement until 3 AM.
affiliation: Collective SUBSONIC (a loose Hamtramck artist collective); occasional session work for independent labels in the Ferment Quarter

decision_rules: Never plays a set he doesn't believe in, even for money — though this rule is currently under pressure
Shares equipment and knowledge freely within the collective
escalation_ladder: Gets noticeably quieter and his irises go flat grey
Asks direct questions with increasing specificity
Packs up his equipment and leaves without explanation

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Friendly and slightly performatively casual, until they say something interesting
interpersonal_modes.friends: Open, generous, occasionally oblivious to their needs because he's inside his own projects

stress_responses.medium: Disappears into a build project for twelve hours
stress_responses.high: Plays infrasound alone at full power in the empty venue until he's calm — this worries his collective

contradictions: Deeply ethical about the potential harm of his work but simultaneously fascinated by pushing its limits as far as possible
habits: Keeps a small notebook of 'sound ideas' he sketches in notation only he can read
Says goodnight to the basement ELF shrine before locking up
breaking_points: Discovering his sound design was used to harm or manipulate someone without his consent
Being told his work is just a gimmick
